concepts.def: Four-layer model: Link, Internet, Transport, Application - underpinning the modern internet.
Connection-oriented transport with handshake, sequence numbers, retransmission and flow control.
Connectionless transport: low overhead, no retransmission; suits streaming and DNS lookups.
32-bit address scheme yielding about 4.3 billion addresses (e.g., 192.168.0.1).
TCP connection setup: SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK between client and server.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Networks & The Internet — a core area of A-Level Computer Science.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Networks & The Internet brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Networks & The Internet.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
